description:
### PixelBoard Patches (v1.3.5)

* **Screen Rotation Grace Period for Rambler Voice Dictation**: Maintains Rambler voice dictation across device display orientation changes by introducing a 1.5s grace period during display rotation, preventing voice typing sessions from abruptly aborting (#146, PR #165 by Francisco Valentim Castilho)
* **Preserve Speech Diff for Mid-Sentence Voice Edits**: Retains speech diffs for voice replacements and mid-sentence voice commands (such as "replace X with Y"), preventing accidental overwriting (#167)
* **Native Split Readiness Gate Check for Gboard 18.6.3**: Added native library readiness gate check for split APK components on Gboard 18.6.3 (`Lsmi;`, `Locf;`) ensuring seamless JNI loading (#168)
* **AI Writing Tools Connection Fix**: Repaired request timeout and prompt template evaluation to restore reliable server connection for Rephrase, Proofreading, and Tone adjustments without "cannot connect to server" errors
* **Morphe Manager Patch Bundle DEX Packaging**: Included `classes.dex` directly in the root of the `.mpp` patch bundle via `:patches:buildAndroid` so Morphe Manager detects and loads all 4 patches out-of-the-box
* **Enhanced Clipboard Retention & 100-Item Cap**: Unpinned clips kept for 24 hours by default, history cap raised from 5 to 100 recent clips, customizable slider (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, Never) and honest duration strings across 83 locales (#129)
* **Gboard v18.6.3 Compatibility**: Full support for Gboard 18.6.3 alongside 18.5.3, 18.4.1, and 18.3.1 with signature bypass, symbol key label sanitization, and RTL/LTR settings polish
* **Restore Voice Toolbar Minimize Key**: Restored the voice toolbar minimize action key in Rambler dictation to minimize the expanded toolbar to the end slot or floating widget (#108)
* **TalkBack Accessibility for Voice Typing Keys**: Added proper accessibility content descriptions for TalkBack screen reader support on the Rambler voice toolbar minimize key ("Minimize keyboard") and floating widget key ("Back to keyboard") (#108)
* **Pre-Activated Google Sans Flex & Undo Actions**: Google Sans Flex typography and Undo action key are pre-enabled and enforced by default
* **In-App Updates**: Dedicated PixelBoard updates section directly in Gboard settings with GitHub release checks, formatted changelogs, and direct APK download
* **Smart Auto-Correction & Dynamic Revert**: Pre-enabled auto-correction with primary-key revert and fine-tuned word learning threshold
* **Standalone Coexistence**: Side-by-side installation with stock Gboard

Supports Gboard v18.6.3 (Release), v18.5.3 (Release), v18.4.1 (Release), and v18.3.1 (Release / Beta).
